quarterly_data.quarter: ASUS press release: ASUS Ready to Ship NVIDIA HGX Rubin NVL8 Systems (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ASUS announced that its new systems built on NVIDIA HGX Rubin NVL8 are ready to launch in Q4 2026, with partial-rack and full-rack configurations: the 3U hybrid-cooled XR R1I12B-M1BHFS (D2C liquid cooling for the HGX Rubin 8-GPU baseboard plus an air-cooled dual Intel Xeon 6 CPU sled that ASUS says reduces maintenance time by up to 50%) and the 2U 100% liquid-cooled XR R1I12B-M1BLFS. ASUS also offers AI factory design and simulation with the NVIDIA DSX Sim Blueprint, integrating infrastructure into a digital twin with ecosystem partners including Schneider Electric, AVEVA and IBM.
quarterly_data.figure: HGX Rubin NVL8 systems ready to launch in Q4 2026
